end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping and slanting lines and separating straight lines from curved lines. They used examples such as stumps, a flagpole, a pencil on a floor, and a bottle; the mix-up about tilted lines was corrected later by checking that a slanting line can still be straight. At home, draw three straight lines in different directions and ask Om to name each one, then add one curved line for comparison.
